That program, called "PROMISE", is meant for interdiction of misdemeanors only. There are many reasons for this, one of which is a Florida State Law that makes a felony out of tampering with any felony record. Hence it seems legal for a school district and police department, for example, to enter into an agreement that for misdemeanors they won't arrest, the DA won't prosecute and the school won't permanently expel. It is a felony, however, under Florida Statutes to tamper with any felony record or proceeding that impacts a state agency (schools are, of course, a state agency).
